body.statement: Let \(K\) be an effective real closed field.  For every finite Boolean combination of polynomial equalities and strict or weak polynomial inequalities with coefficients in \(K\), cylindrical algebraic decomposition terminates, decides whether its realization in a finite-dimensional affine space is empty, and, when it is nonempty, returns an exact represented sample point.  This decision-and-sampling conclusion applies to open and positive-dimensional semialgebraic realizations as well as to zero-dimensional ones.
